buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 2. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 3. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 4. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 5. Generic Without prejudice to Buyer’s right to price adjustment by way of discount or any other right or remedy available to Buyer, Buyer may terminate the Contract or any part thereof by a written notice to the Seller, if: i) The Seller fails to comply with any material term of the Contract. ii) The Seller informs Buyer of its inability to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period or such inability otherwise becomes apparent. iii) The Seller fails to deliver the Material(s) or any part thereof within the stipulated Delivery Period and/or to replace/rectify any rejected or defective Material(s) promptly. iv) The Seller becomes bankrupt or goes into liquidation. v) The Seller makes a general assignment for the benefit of creditors. vi) A receiver is appointed for any substantial property owned by the Seller.

vii) The Seller has misrepresented to Buyer, acting on which misrepresentation Buyer has placed the Purchase Order on the Seller. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SCOPE OF WORK HPCL will supply cathode, anode electrodes and electrolytes for cell fabrication. 1.Fabrication and supply of cells with the following specifications: Li-ion cells: 3.7 V, 10 kWh, Na-ion cells: 3.2 V, 10 kWh 2. Minimum cell size (form factor) should be 32140, 4680, or equivalent formats with tabless desig n 3. The cells should be fabricated using commercial-grade components, including separators, curre nt collectors, cans, caps, electrolyte, and other standard materials. 4. All the process involved in cell making like calendaring (if required), electrode winding, tab welding/tab-less, electrolyte filling, sealing/crimping, formation, aging, and quality testing are in the scope of the vendor. 5. Vendor must also perform necessary process optimization based on HPCL electrode characteristics/equipment 6. All prototype cells shall complete the required formation process and the first three charge discharge cycles prior to delivery. 7. Minimum 20% of the delivered prototype cells shall undergo a minimum of 50 charge–discharge cycles using industry-standard C-rates 8. The vendor shall submit all quality control, manufacturing, and electrochemical characterization data related to the prototype cells to HPCL at various stages of the cell fabrication process. DELIVERY PERIOD 12 months from the Purchase Order date. DELIVERY LOCATION Deliver 10 kWh of Li-ion cells and 10 kWh Na-ion cells. Final delivery location shall be Hindustan P etroleum Corporation Limited, HP Green R&D Centre, KIADB, Industrial Area, Tarabanahalli, Devan agundi, Hoskote, Bangalore - 560 067, Karnataka, India.

PRICE REDUCTION CLAUSE / LIQUIDATED DAMAGES Applicable as per GEM Terms and Conditions. FREE ISSUE MATERIAL Vendor must submit free issue material bank guarantee value of ₹ 1,00,000.00 (One Lakh Rupees only) as per format attached in ATC document. CPBG / RETENTION Applicable as per HPCL’s General Terms and Conditions of Works Contract. (Attached in ‘Buyer added Bid S pecific ATC) · Quantum: 5% of total value shall be applicable. SECURITY DEPOSIT Applicable as per HPCL’s General Terms and Conditions of Works Contract. (Attached in ‘Buyer added Bid S pecific ATC) · Quantum: 2% of total value shall be applicable. PAYMENT TERMS · The vendor shall raise the invoice after completion of the scope of work as specified in the ten der. · Payment will be made within 30 working days of the final completion of the scope of work as a greed by HPCL, subject to receipt of the original/digital invoice along with the service report dul y signed by both parties. DECLARATION FORMS Vendor to submit the following declarations mandatorily along with the bid as per format attached with the tender document. · Banned or Delisted or Blacklisted · Total Acceptance Letter without any deviation OTHER TERMS & CONDITIONS AND IMPORTANT INFORMAITON.
